Cluj-Napoca, Romania | Hybrid | Full-time
 Build better technology. Make an impact together. 
 At Kingfisher, we're bringing together technology, people and fresh thinking to shape the future of home improvement.
With over 74,000 colleagues across brands including B&Q, Screwfix, Castorama, Brico Dépôt and Koçtaş, we're part of an international business with ambitious plans for the future.
Our technology teams play an important role in this journey, and we're looking for an Mobile Quality Engineer (Junior) to join us in Cluj-Napoca.
In this role, you'll help ensure the quality and reliability of our B&Q and TradePoint native mobile applications across Android and iOS, working closely with experienced engineers while developing your skills in mobile testing and automation.
 What's the job? 
 Role Overview
 We are going through an exciting period of change and are seeking a motivated, curious and eager to learn Mobile Quality Engineer to join our Engineering team in Cluj. You will help ensure the quality and reliability of our B&Q and TradePoint native apps on Android and iOS – testing both platforms hands-on and growing your skills in Android test automation, alongside experienced Software and Quality Engineers.
We aspire to grow a world-class engineering function, pioneering in the retail technology space, and making great software within a growth culture that is always looking for the next thing to improve or adapt to meet our customers’ needs.
If you're looking for an exciting opportunity to step out of your comfort zone and make a real impact by building better software, this is the job for you!
 What you'll be doing Test Planning 
 Understand and break down requirements to determine what needs testing – functionality, usability, accessibility and analytics. 
 Work with your squad to agree the test scope for each feature and contribute to estimation. 
 Write clear test cases and keep them up to date in our test management tool. 
 Test Execution (Android & iOS) 
 Test new features and bug fixes on Android and iOS native apps, across front end, API/integration and regression levels. 
 Take part in release testing – regression and smoke test runs before each app release. 
 Verify analytics and tracking events and inspect API traffic using proxy tools. 
 Test Automation (Android) 
 Write and maintain automated UI tests for the Android app, with support from team members. 
 Help keep the nightly test suite green: investigate failures, fix flaky tests, and update test data and network mocks. 
 Learn and apply automation best practice – the right balance between unit, contract/integration and end-to-end tests. 
 Defect Management 
 Detect, reproduce, report and track defects with clear steps, logs and evidence. 
 Work closely with developers to troubleshoot issues and verify fixes. 
 Flag critical issues early so they can be prioritised and resolved quickly. 
 Ways of Working 
 Be the voice of quality in your squad and contribute to continuous improvement through retrospectives and feedback sessions. 
 Contribute to show & tell sessions to communicate with stakeholders. 
 What You'll Bring
 What you'll bring 
 Either 2+ years of experience as a QA/QE Engineer, or at least 1 year of hands-on experience in test automation. 
 Some practical exposure to test automation (e.g. writing or maintaining UI or API tests in any language or framework) and a willingness to grow in Android UI automation. 
 Experience testing native mobile apps (Android and/or iOS) on real devices and emulators/simulators. 
 Experience inspecting and debugging REST or GraphQL APIs, e.g. with Charles Proxy, Proxyman or Postman. 
 Familiarity with Jira or similar defect tracking and test management tools. 
 Understanding of Quality Assurance within Agile methodologies. 
 Analytical mindset, attention to detail and good troubleshooting skills. 
 Clear communication in English, both written and spoken. 
 Nice To Have
 Android UI automation in Kotlin – Espresso, Compose UI testing or UI Automator. 
 Git and CI pipelines (e.g. GitLab CI). 
 Test management with Xray. 
 Testing analytics and marketing SDKs (e.g. Tealium, AppsFlyer, Optimizely, Braze). 
 Mobile accessibility testing (TalkBack, VoiceOver). 
 Exposure to XCUITest. 
 What we offer 
 Flexibility & work-life balance
 Hybrid working model in Cluj-Napoca 
 Flexible working hours 
 21 days of annual leave, increasing with tenure up to 25 days 
 Additional days off when public holidays fall on weekends 
 Paid leave for special life events 
 Health & wellbeing
 Private medical coverage through Regina Maria (Priority Plan) 
 Option to extend medical coverage to your spouse or children at no additional cost 
 Life insurance through Metropolitan Life 
 Co-funded Wellhub (7Card) fitness membership 
 Eyeglasses vouchers 
 Rewards & Everyday Benefits
 Annual performance bonus 
 Meal vouchers 
 Gift vouchers for special occasions, up to four times per year 
 Employee referral bonus 
 Fresh fruit, premium coffee and a modern, collaborative workspace 
 Learning & development
 Access to LinkedIn Learning, LEO Learning and Bookster 
 Opportunities to develop your skills and grow your career within an international organisation 
 Our culture: We are open. We are brave. We win together. 
 At Kingfisher, we believe that great things happen when people feel empowered to share ideas, challenge existing ways of working and support one another.
Our culture is built around curiosity, courage, collaboration and continuous improvement.
Our customers come from all walks of life, and so do we. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is treated fairly, respected and given the opportunity to succeed, regardless of their background or identity.
 You don't need to tick every box to make a difference. If this opportunity excites you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement.
